description: This file declares functions for hash lookups, including searching for object IDs and binary search within hash tables, and defines related data types and constants.

methods.name: oid_pos
methods.description: Finds the position of an object ID within a table, using a custom access function.

methods.name: bsearch_hash
methods.description: Performs binary search for a hash in a table using a fanout array to determine search interval.
